mapper.sql: id, leave_request_id AS leaveRequestId, task_id AS taskId, approver_id AS approverId, approver_role AS approverRole, decision, comment, completed_at AS completedAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flowable_leave_approval ( leave_request_id, task_id, approver_id, approver_role, decision, comment, completed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{leaveRequestId}, #{taskId}, #{approverId}, #{approverRole}, #{decision}, #{comment}, COALESCE(#{completedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flowable_leave_approval WHERE leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} ORDER BY completed_at ASC, id ASC
